mathematical_contract.nontriple_repeated_root: For P=a*x^3+b*x^2+c*x+d with delta0=b^2-3*a*c nonzero, a repeated root is (9*a*d-b*c)/(2*delta0). The proposed factor is therefore (b*c-9*a*d)+2*delta0*x.
mathematical_contract.triple_root: When delta0 is identically zero, delta1=2*b^3-9*a*b*c+27*a^2*d must also vanish before 3*a*x+b may be proposed as a triple-root factor.
mathematical_contract.specialization_rejection: A genuine repeated factor makes the cubic discriminant relation delta1^2-4*delta0^3 vanish identically. A nonzero exact value at the fixed bivariate specialization rejects repetition; a zero or unresolved value makes no positive claim.
mathematical_contract.derivative_remainder: For a nontriple candidate B+D*x, the exact cleared derivative value 3*a*B^2-2*b*B*D+c*D^2 must be structurally zero before component extraction.
mathematical_contract.division_authority: The normalized candidate must divide the complete trivariate tensor exactly and must divide the resulting quotient exactly. Every bivariate intermediate remainder is exact; invariants alone never authorize a factor or its multiplicity.
mathematical_contract.selected_sign: Verified factors and quotients replay one bounded recursive authority composed from the existing structural, Bernstein, affine, linear-resultant, binary selected-root, quadratic-factor, and repeated-cubic paths. A selected zero factor proves the full product zero; decided nonzero signs multiply exactly.
mathematical_contract.quotient_order: An authored four-coefficient cubic axis is replayed before defining-polynomial quotient reduction because reduction preserves the selected value but may expand the authored factorization. Failed square-free originals are recorded and are not retried later.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: All bivariate products and reconstructed trivariate tensors use checked dimensions and the existing 16384-control ceiling. Candidate content removal uses the shared Hypersolve authority. Factor materialization is delayed until both exact divisions pass.
mathematical_contract.policy: A supportable repeated-cubic factorization is Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. A square-free cubic control remains Predicate uncertainty in STRICT and may return Zero only after APPROXIMATE_512 records Approximate512Consumed.
mathematical_contract.failure: Nonzero specialization, derivative, or triple-root invariants; unresolved exact coefficient signs; failed component extraction; either failed exact division; resource overflow; square-free unsupported cubics; and higher-degree axes make no exact claim. No tolerance, sampled positive factor, guessed root, compatibility shim, or second Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.differential_factor_coverage: Dense authored double and triple products split and reconstruct exactly on all three axes. A square-free arithmetic-progression cubic that satisfies the root formula is rejected because the candidate does not divide twice. x^3+1 is rejected because delta-one is nonzero despite delta-zero vanishing.
capability.remaining_policy_control: The zero factor multiplied by two distinct strictly positive coupled multi-affine factors is square-free cubic on every axis. The bounded factor package deliberately declines it; STRICT remains explicitly uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 returns Zero only with Approximate512Consumed.
capability.remaining_exactness_boundary: Recover bounded square-free cubic factors or construct a bounded compositum only when quotient, relation, axis-content, quadratic-factor, and repeated-cubic paths all fail.
